title: No signal? No problem

slides.html:
Offline

No signal at the track?

Keep logging.

slides.label: The problem
slides.html:
Losing signal stops the data going in.

  • The paddock has one bar, or none.
  • Sessions wait to be written up later.
  • By the evening, half the detail is gone.

slides.label: Offline
slides.html:
Open it the day before. Work offline all weekend.

1

The night before

Open Kart Connect while you have signal, so everything you need is downloaded.

2

At the track

Log every session, signal or not.

3

Back on signal

It all syncs, at the track or back at the hotel.

slides.label: For teams
slides.html:
Mechanics scan in. The data comes back to you.

1

Send a QR code

The team manager sends each mechanic their own QR code.

2

Scan and submit

The mechanic scans it and enters the setup.

3

Back to the manager

It reaches the team manager, and syncs as soon as there is a connection.

captions:
No signal at the track? Keep logging.

Open Kart Connect the day before so everything is downloaded, then log every session offline. It syncs as soon as you're back on signal, at the track or back at the hotel. Running a team? Send each mechanic a QR code: they scan it, submit the setup, and it comes straight back to you when there's a connection.

How many sessions have you written up from memory because the paddock had no signal?

With Kart Connect you work offline all weekend and it syncs later. Mechanics can submit setups by QR code, and the team manager gets them the moment there's a connection.
